description: Header file defining serialization codes, tensor metadata handling, and backend serialization functions for PyTorch JIT.

classes.name: WriteableTensorData
classes.description: Structure representing writable tensor data for serialization.

methods.name: getWriteableTensorData
methods.description: Returns tensor data suitable for serialization, optionally converting CUDA tensors to CPU.

methods.name: checkHasValidSetGetState
methods.description: Checks if a class has valid __getstate__/__setstate__ methods.

methods.name: GetBackendMetaAllowlist
methods.description: Returns the set of device types allowed for backend metadata serialization.

methods.name: GetBackendMetaSerialization
methods.description: Obtains serialization function pairs for backend-specific tensor metadata.

methods.name: getTensorMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata (like 'conj' and 'neg') for a tensor, including custom backend info.

methods.name: setTensorMetadata
methods.description: Sets tensor metadata based on a provided map or dictionary.

methods.name: TensorBackendMetaRegistry
methods.description: Registers serialization functions for tensor backend metadata for a specific device type.
